title: Whirlpool Washer F5E2 Error Code - Door Latch / Lid Lock Fault Fix
description: Whirlpool washer code F5E2 indicates the main control board detects the door switch or lid lock assembly is not locking correctly.
symptoms: Lid lock light flashes red or blinks
Door fails to lock during spin cycle
possibleCauses: Damaged or broken lid latch strike
solutions: Disconnect power to the washer for 5 minutes to reset the control board.
Check lid latch mechanism for physical obstruction, debris, or broken plastic tabs.
Inspect wiring harness running between the lock switch and control unit for loose pins.
Test lid lock switch for electrical continuity using a multimeter; replace lock assembly if open circuit.
seoKeywords: how to fix F5E2 code Whirlpool

title: Whirlpool Washer F1E1 Error Code - Main Control Board Primary Failure
description: Whirlpool washer code F1E1 signals a critical primary hardware failure on the main electronic control unit (CCU).
possibleCauses: Power surge damage to control board
solutions: Perform a hard reset by unplugging the unit for 10 minutes.
Inspect control board for burnt components, blown capacitors, or scorch marks.
Check incoming voltage at wall outlet to verify stable power supply.
Replace main electronic control board if error persists after hard reset.

title: Whirlpool Washer F0E5 Error Code - Off-Balance Load Detected
description: F0E5 code indicates an off-balance wash load prevented the unit from reaching full spin speed.
solutions: Pause cycle and manually redistribute heavy clothing or towels inside drum.
Use a spirit level to verify all four washer leveling feet are flat on floor.
Inspect all 4 suspension rods for broken springs or lost damping force.
Replace suspension dampening rod kit if drum bounces excessively when pressed down.

title: Whirlpool Washer F8E1 Error Code - Long Fill / No Water Inlet Fault
description: F8E1 (LF) triggers when the washer fails to fill with water within the expected time limit.
symptoms: Washer hums but no water enters drum
Cycle stalls at water fill step
possibleCauses: Clogged water inlet valve screen filters
Home water supply valve turned off
solutions: Ensure hot and cold home water valves are fully open.
Check inlet fill hoses for kinks or severe bends restricting flow.
Disconnect inlet hoses and clean mesh sediment filter screens inside water valve.
Test inlet valve solenoids with a multimeter and replace dual water inlet valve if faulty.

title: Whirlpool Dryer E1 F3 Error Code - Thermistor Temperature Sensor Open Fault
description: E1 F3 error indicates an open electrical circuit in the dryer thermistor temperature sensor.
symptoms: Dryer runs but clothes remain wet
solutions: Clean lint filter and exhaust duct line completely to ensure unrestricted airflow.
Test thermal fuse on blower housing for continuity; replace if blown.
Measure thermistor resistance (approx 10k ohms at room temperature); replace thermistor if open circuit.
Inspect wiring harness connections between sensor and main board.
seoKeywords: Whirlpool dryer E1 F3 error code

title: Samsung Washer 4C / 4E Error Code - Water Supply Line Inflow Fault
description: Samsung washer 4C (formerly 4E) indicates water is not entering the tub within the designated time frame.
possibleCauses: Clogged mesh filter in water inlet hose connections
solutions: Turn off supply tap, remove fill hoses, and flush mesh filter screens under running water.
Inspect supply hoses for severe kinks or pinches behind the machine.
Check water pressure from wall valve directly into a bucket.
Replace water inlet valve assembly if screens are clean but water flow is blocked electrically.
partName: Water Inlet Hose Mesh Filters & Valve
seoKeywords: how to clear 4C error Samsung washer

title: Samsung Washer 5C / 5E Error Code - Water Drain Failure
description: Samsung 5C (or 5E) signals the washer failed to pump water out of the drum during drain cycle.
symptoms: Tub remains filled with soapy water
Humming sound from lower drain filter
possibleCauses: Clogged debris filter on drain pump
Kinked or clogged external drain hose
Objects trapped in drain impeller (coins, socks)
solutions: Open access door at bottom front, drain standing water manually, and clean debris filter tube.
Verify standpipe drain hose is positioned properly without kinks or tight bends.
Inspect drain pump impeller blades for trapped debris or coins.
Test drain pump motor for power and replace pump if motor hums without turning.

title: Samsung Washer UB / UE Error Code - Unbalanced Load Protection
description: UB (Unbalanced) or UE code triggers when load distribution prevents safe high-speed spin.
symptoms: Washer attempts spin then slows down repeatedly
UB code appears on control display
possibleCauses: Single bulky item (blanket/rug) caught on one side
solutions: Open door, untangle laundry, and evenly space heavy garments around drum.
Adjust leveling feet beneath cabinet using a level tool until fully stable.
Check drum bounce by pressing down from top; if drum swings loosely, replace 4 suspension rods.
seoKeywords: Samsung washer thumping noise spin cycle

title: Samsung Refrigerator 22E Error Code - Evaporator Fan Motor Circuit Failure
description: Samsung 22E indicates the main board detects no feedback signal from the fresh food evaporator fan motor.
symptoms: Fridge compartment warm while freezer cold
Whirring or grinding noise behind rear panel
possibleCauses: Frost buildup blocking fan blade rotation
solutions: Perform a full 24-hour manual defrost to clear ice accumulation behind food compartment panel.
Remove back internal duct wall and check fan blade for obstruction or motor stiffness.
Test fan motor harness for proper DC voltage signal from main board.
Replace fresh food evaporator fan motor assembly.

title: Samsung Refrigerator 33E Error Code - Ice Pipe Heater Line Fault
description: 33E code signifies an open or short circuit in the ice maker water fill tube heater element.
symptoms: Water fill pipe behind ice room frozen solid
possibleCauses: Ice room door seal leak admitting moist air
solutions: Thaw frozen water supply line entering ice room using warm air or manual defrost.
Inspect ice room gaskets for tears allowing warm air intrusion.
Measure resistance of ice pipe heater circuit with multimeter.
Replace ice fill tube heater line or ice maker assembly.

Washer stops prior to spin cycle
solutions: Unclip small drain hose at front lower door panel, drain water into bucket, and unscrew filter plug to clean debris.

Listen for drain pump motor sound; if motor hums without spinning or remains silent, replace pump assembly.

title: LG Washer IE Error Code - Water Inlet Timeout Fault
description: LG IE error triggers when water level fails to reach appropriate threshold within allowed fill time.
symptoms: Low water flow during fill cycle
solutions: Verify home hot and cold water taps are turned fully counterclockwise.
Unscrew fill hoses from back of washer and clean stainless steel filter screens with a brush.
Inspect hoses for kinks or blockages.
Replace dual inlet valve if screens are clear and home water pressure is normal.

title: LG Washer UE / uE Error Code - Unbalanced Load Balance Correction
description: UE error indicates an imbalanced load. Lowercase 'uE' means machine is attempting auto-correction; uppercase 'UE' requires manual intervention.
symptoms: Spin cycle fails to reach max speed
Washer attempts re-fill to balance load
possibleCauses: Mixed heavy and light items (towels with shirts)
Worn suspension dampers or tub springs
solutions: Pause cycle and re-arrange laundry evenly inside tub.
Verify all 4 leveling feet rest firmly on floor surface and lock nuts are tightened.
Inspect suspension dampeners for fluid leakage or loss of resistance.

difference between uE and UE LG washer

Measure voltage supply at fan harness connector during cooling call.

possibleCauses: Crushed metal vent pipe behind unit
Exterior wall hood flap stuck closed
solutions: Disconnect exhaust duct pipe from rear of dryer and clean wall duct using vent cleaning brush.
Verify exterior exhaust hood flap opens freely when dryer runs.

Clean dryer internal lint trap housing thoroughly.

Clean mesh filter screens located at water inlet valve connections.
Inspect pressure switch air tube for kinks, water blockages, or cuts.
Replace dual water valve assembly if electrical solenoids fail continuity tests.

Test drain pump motor winding resistance using a multimeter.
Replace drain pump assembly if motor fails to operate when power is applied.

possibleCauses: Hole in water line or drain pump seal
solutions: Unplug unit, tilt dishwasher forward at 45-degree angle to drain trapped water from lower pan.
Tighten sump tub mounting screws located inside floor of dishwasher.
Inspect lower door seal and side gaskets for tears or misalignment.
Locate and repair source of water drip before restarting cycle.

title: Bosch Dishwasher E24 Error Code - Drain Flow Restriction Fault

symptoms: Standing water in bottom filter cup
E24 code displays shortly after starting cycle
possibleCauses: Garbage disposal knockout plug not removed
solutions: Remove coarse and fine stainless steel filters from tub floor and wash under hot water.
Check garbage disposal entry port for obstruction or unremoved plastic knockout plug.
Remove white plastic drain pump cover inside sump and check impeller for seed or bone blockage.
Verify drain hose is free of kinks and elevated in high loop.

title: Frigidaire Washer E11 Error Code - Fill Time Too Long

Clean inlet screen filters on rear water connections.
Check water valve solenoids for proper resistance.
Replace water inlet valve if water flow remains poor.

title: Frigidaire Washer E20 Error Code - Drain Problem / Pump Fault
description: E20 or E21 indicates the washer is taking too long to pump water out of the machine.

Ensure drain hose is installed without kinks or restrictions.
Test drain pump winding with multimeter.
Replace drain pump motor assembly if defective.

title: Maytag Washer F5E2 Error Code - Door Lock Switch Failure
description: Maytag washer code F5E2 occurs when control board cannot verify the door lock switch position.

solutions: Perform hard power reset by disconnecting washer for 5 minutes.
Inspect lid latch strike for damage.
Check continuity of door lock switch.
Replace door lock latch assembly if switch fails continuity testing.

title: Maytag Washer SD / Sud Error Code - Excessive Foam Detection
description: SD or Sud code triggers when control board senses excessive suds in outer tub during cycle.
solutions: Allow suds to dissolve naturally; do not add extra soap.
Switch exclusively to High-Efficiency (HE) detergent formulas.
Reduce detergent dose by half for soft water or light loads.
Run clean washer cycle with affresh cleaner tab to clear residue.

title: KitchenAid Dishwasher HE Error Code - Heating Element Fault

solutions: Unplug unit and check heating element element for cracks or corrosion.
Test heating element continuity with multimeter (approx 10-30 ohms).
Check high-limit thermostat switch for continuity.
Replace heating element if open circuit.

description: Kenmore F02 code indicates drain pump is taking longer than 8 minutes to empty wash water.
